why: A thinking:xhigh release evidence change needs a separate attempt to falsify its guarantees

decision: Make each upstream record own its release facts
why: Repeating versions, repositories, licenses, or patch status lets individually correct checks disagree
evidence: Reflaxe provenance owns Reflaxe facts; stdlib ledger owns Haxe facts; haxelib metadata owns the project license declaration; generated artifacts consume them
result: Notice and SBOM inputs now converge without independently copied upstream facts

decision: Reject package inputs that are not part of the release commit
why: The package builder reads whole directories and two optional root files, so ignored or untracked bytes could otherwise ship
evidence: package-input-cleanliness checks src, std, runtime, vendor, Run.hx, and run.n; adversarial tests cover untracked and ignored payloads
result: Normal and repair release paths now fail before packaging commit-unowned bytes

decision: Accept the implementation evidence before Oracle handoff
why: The origin and licensing record must not change generated Rust or permit unreviewed package bytes
evidence: 143 exact snapshot output lanes passed; hooks:check passed; real package and strict verifier passed; package smoke passed; codex-hxrust portable and metal Cargo gates passed; independent gpt-5.6-sol review approved
